ITEM 1 | Round slices of reddish-brown cured sausage, each with a dark brown outer rim and a lighter pinkish-orange interior cut face, smooth matte skin with slight sheen, firm and holding shape, cut crosswise into discs about 3 cm across and 1.5 cm thick, some slices stacked or overlapping, sitting on a white foam plate about 26 cm across | 150

ITEM 2 | Small pile of additional sausage discs in the same reddish-brown cured appearance, some with visible pale fat-free interior and slightly darker browned edges, firm texture, a few overlapping the main group near the center of the plate | 60
